Entries.Original: Kunimi has the ability to heal allies.
If an ally's deflector is close to depleted, heal them before it's too late.
Now, muster your strength. You want to win this, don't you?
Kunimi is a Healer.\nShe is proficient at healing her teammates.
However, some skills, including healing, have limited uses.\nMake sure to use them wisely!
